'''Lanoree Brock's Peacemaker''' was the personal [[Peacemaker-class cruiser|''Peacemaker''-class cruiser]] of [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] during the [[Stargazer Uprising]]. [[Ironholgs]], an upgraded [[Holgorian IM-220]] [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]], was assigned to security and maintenance of the ship, and was capable of remotely piloting it.<ref name="Into the Void" />
